name: Stencl
tagline: The booking and deposit platform for multi-location tattoo studios.
positioning: Stencl runs scheduling, deposits, consent forms, and artist payouts for studio groups — so every chair stays booked and every dollar is accounted for.

hero.h1: Every chair booked. Every deposit reconciled.
hero.sub: Stencl gives studio groups one system for online booking, refundable deposits, consent and aftercare forms, and same-day artist payouts across every location.

features.title: Multi-location booking
features.description: Route clients to the right artist and chair across every studio, with per-location hours, deposit rules, and cancellation windows enforced automatically.

features.title: Deposits that reconcile
features.description: Collect refundable deposits at booking, apply them at checkout, and match every transaction to a payout — no more spreadsheet math at month-end.

features.title: Consent & aftercare forms
features.description: Digital consent, medical intake, and aftercare sign-off captured before the needle drops, timestamped and stored for your compliance team.

features.title: Artist payouts
features.description: Split revenue by commission or booth rent, then pay artists same-day with a full ledger they can actually read and trust.

features.title: Chair utilization reporting
features.description: See fill rate, no-show cost, and revenue per chair by location and artist — the numbers your regional managers ask for every Monday.

features.title: Roles for franchise ops
features.description: Give owners, managers, and front-desk staff exactly the access they need, with audit logs across the entire studio network.

testimonials.quote: We rolled Stencl across 14 studios in a quarter. No-shows dropped because deposits finally stick, and our month-end reconciliation went from three days to an afternoon.
testimonials.name: Marisol Vega

testimonials.quote: Our artists were skeptical about another system. Then they saw payouts land same-day with a ledger they could read. Adoption stopped being a fight.
testimonials.name: Derek Ostrowski

testimonials.quote: Consent and aftercare forms used to live in binders per shop. Stencl gave our compliance team one timestamped record across every location. That closed a real audit gap.
testimonials.name: Priya Ramachandran

pricing.blurb: For single studios moving off paper and generic calendar tools.
For multi-location groups that need shared operations and payouts.
For franchise networks with procurement, SSO, and audit needs.

homepage.footerBlurb: Stencl is the operations platform for professional tattoo studio groups — booking, deposits, consent, and payouts in one accountable system.
